verdict.rationale: The only document-generation offering evidenced is the Lowenstein x Clerky partnership, which is explicitly paid ($299 for Post-Incorporation Setup, $149 for 83(b) add-on) and framed as a service for 'clients,' not a free public generator usable without becoming a client. No evidence shows free downloadable SAFEs, term sheets, NDAs, or incorporation forms available to non-clients.
